To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the visual alphabet representation can be incrementally learned, and (2) the alphabet enables sharing of shape features across categories, which reduces the number of required features per class and often improves performance.

we have shown how to incrementally learn a visual shape alphabet that can be used to learn object detectors, and that the resulting detectors outperform detectors that are learnt on a per category basis.
We introduce a visual alphabet for shape-based object detection and a learning algorithm which enables incremental additions of object categories.
In summary, our research is concerned with
incremental learning of detectors for object categories.
the problem of learning a multiclass system of object detectors.
the development of an object detection system that can be incrementally extended with new categories, and which is able to learn to detect objects (as opposed to classifying images).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we have developed a new approach which enables us to incrementally build a large scale system for object detection, which is able to learn from a few examples, is able to learn new categories incrementally and which is able to share information across categories.
the visual alphabet approach is a very promising approach to object detection and classification.
the proposed approach is a very promising and effective method for learning object detectors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the alphabet representation allows us to learn detectors incrementally for complex visual categories.
we propose an incremental multiclass detector which is capable of learning a visual alphabet, and which is shown to improve performance and reduce complexity.
we present a novel incremental learning framework which can be applied in a large scale setting, and which can benefit from previous learning experience.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to build object detectors incrementally, and to share shape features between object categories.
a small visual alphabet can be used to represent the shape of a large number of object categories, and that this representation can be learnt incrementaly.
a visual shape alphabet can be learnt incrementaly and can be used to learn multiclass object detectors.
